labels.label: not_relevant
labels.note: Escalation and expansion tumor lists are gastric, colorectal, NSCLC and HNSCC only.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Patient must have a primary diagnosis of malignancy and radiographic evidence of bone metastases.

labels.note: Painful bone metastasis procedure study; her metastases are in the lungs (and a treated brain lesion), no bone disease stated.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors including: squamous cell cancer (SCC) of the head and neck, esophageal SCC, squamous and non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer, small cell lung cancer, bladder cancer, sarcoma
Patients with history of prior central nervous system (CNS) metastasis must have been treated, be asymptomatic, and not have concurrent treatment for CNS disease

labels.note: Sarcoma is a listed tumor type; metastatic, measurable, treated stable brain metastasis, no prior B7-H3 or TOP1 ADC.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Patients who are willing to forego standard therapies known to confer benefit
Patient must have undergone RNA testing in a Clinical Laboratory Improvement Act (CLIA) environment or must submit archival tissue to determine RNA overexpression of ADC TOIs by the TARGET Assay.
Patients should have received no more than 3 prior lines of chemotherapy in the advanced/metastatic setting.

labels.note: Approved next-generation TRK therapy remains, so entry rests on the forego-standard prong; Trop-2/Nectin-4/HER2 expression untested.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: soft tissue sarcoma, and NUT carcinoma

Patients who have failed at least 1 prior therapy and, who have no standard treatment options demonstrated to provide clinical benefit or who are intolerable to or refuse further standard therapies will be enrolled.
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status: 0 to 1

labels.note: STS is listed; a next-generation TRK inhibitor is still a standard option, so entry depends on the refusal prong.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Have histologic or cytologic confirmation of advanced sarcoma of the selected histologic subtype that is not amenable to local curative therapy. Participant must have received at least 2, but no more than 4 prior lines of systemic therapy.
Documented radiologic assessment of progression on the prior therapy before study entry.

labels.note: Two prior lines and progression on larotrectinib fit; selected subtypes not listed in criteria (conditions name LMS/DDLPS).
